summary.en: Drive the rover to the far survey sites without wrecking it or draining the battery.
summary.ar: Drive the rover to the far survey sites without wrecking it or draining the battery.

briefing.en: The rover is server-simulated: send throttle/heading or engage autopilot, then tick.
briefing.ar: The rover is server-simulated: send throttle/heading or engage autopilot, then tick.

briefing.en: Hazards damage the chassis; damage lowers top speed.
briefing.ar: Hazards damage the chassis; damage lowers top speed.

hint.en: Climb in and switch to rover activity (low oxygen drain).
hint.ar: Climb in and switch to rover activity (low oxygen drain).

hint.en: Pick a waypoint on the nav console, then drive.
hint.ar: Pick a waypoint on the nav console, then drive.

hint.en: Reach Survey Ridge and Sample Site Alpha, then log the traverse.
hint.ar: Reach Survey Ridge and Sample Site Alpha, then log the traverse.

hint.en: Finish the rover run first (POST simulation/tick).
hint.ar: Finish the rover run first (POST simulation/tick).

success_message.en: Traverse logged. Both survey sites reached.
success_message.ar: Traverse logged. Both survey sites reached.

hint.en: Park, set the brake and step out.
hint.ar: Park, set the brake and step out.

hint.en: Leave a transponder so the return route is marked.
hint.ar: Leave a transponder so the return route is marked.

message.en: The traverse is not finished – keep driving before you log it.
message.ar: The traverse is not finished – keep driving before you log it.

summary.en: Far sites reached. Geological sampling is now possible.
summary.ar: Far sites reached. Geological sampling is now possible.

reason.en: Hazard hits and detours cost energy.
reason.ar: Hazard hits and detours cost energy.

topic.en: Rover driving is slow and careful
topic.ar: Rover driving is slow and careful

detail.en: Perseverance drives tens to a few hundred metres per sol; terrain relative navigation and hazard avoidance matter more than speed.
detail.ar: Perseverance drives tens to a few hundred metres per sol; terrain relative navigation and hazard avoidance matter more than speed.

disclaimer: Educational game simulation. Rover dynamics are game-scaled, not a mobility model.
